menus.note: Operator October 5 launch release announces this exact Daimaru branch. Deep checked official site/shop list, linked menu.php and Instagram, Daimaru site, local opening reports and branch-specific price searches. Operator menu is brand-wide with store-dependent availability; local Pan Navi and Kansai Navi prices are explicitly reference prices and do not establish this counter’s payable launch prices. Only launch-release named offerings are shown, with prices unpublished; full branch assortment, prices and completed gallery remain gaps. Rendering is exact future counter, explicitly labelled. Existing Minamisenba Shinsaibashi shop has a different address, phone and hours and is not substituted.

pin.title: Yakiniku Reimen Gensuke — Fukuoka Opens in Yakuin
pin.description: Gensuke’s first Fukuoka branch is planned for November 2026 near Yakuin Station, serving grade-5 wagyu and cold noodles. Exact opening day is not announced.
pin.address: 3F Yakuin Royal Building, 1-21-15 Shirogane, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Employer-operated recruitment explicitly states November 2026, corroborated by local reporting. November 30 is a month-end sorting placeholder, not a confirmed opening day.
